answer_1.quote: We pose both knowledge graph link prediction and question answering as sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) tasks and tackled successfully with a single encoder-decoder Transformer... For KG link prediction... the output sequence is expected to be the answer to this query... For KGQA... the output sequences are the text mentions of the answer entity.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text sequences for entity names in link prediction and answer entities in question answering

answer_2.quote: We used MRR, Hits@1, Hits@3, Hits@10 for link prediction... For KGQA, we report hits@1 performance...
